faqs.q: Drawing Plan kitne din me banta hai?
faqs.a: Drawing Plan aam tor par 7 se 15 din me tayar ho jata hai — plot size aur floors par depend karta hai. Pehle Layout Plan banta hai, phir Structure, Electrical aur Plumbing Plan.

faqs.q: Gray Structure me kya kya aata hai?
faqs.a: Gray Structure me Foundation, Columns, Beams, Slab, Brickwork aur Plaster aata hai — yani building ka Iron Frame / haddiyon wala dhancha. Finishing isme shamil nahi hoti.

faqs.q: Interior Design ki cost kaise pata chalegi?
faqs.a: Interior ki cost room size, material aur design par depend karti hai. Apna plot size aur rooms batayen — Qivbuild pehle free estimate dega, phir final plan banayega.

faqs.q: Town Planning me kya kya hota hai?
faqs.a: Town Planning me poore town ka Master Plan hota hai — Roads, Plots, Parks, Market aur Sewerage ka naksha. Ye Building Style se alag hota hai — ye poore sheher ka plan hai.

faqs.q: Renovation kitne time me hoti hai?
faqs.a: Chhoti Renovation 2 se 4 hafte me aur poora ghar 2 se 4 mahine me ho jata hai. Pehle purana structure check hota hai, phir naya plan banta hai.
Qivbuild DHA Phase 8 Lahore se poore Lahore aur aas paas ke shehron me kaam karta hai — Drawing Plan se Construction tak.

faqs.q: Kya Qivbuild Approval Drawings bhi banata hai?
faqs.a: Ji haan — LDA / TMA ke liye Approval Drawings, Submission Drawings aur NOC wala plan bhi banaya jata hai.

faqs.q: Commercial Building aur Resident Building me farq kya hai?
faqs.a: Resident Building ghar / villa hota hai — rehne ke liye. Commercial Building plaza / office / shop hota hai — business ke liye. Dono ke Style bhi alag hote hain.

faqs.q: Banquet Hall Planning me kya shamil hai?
faqs.a: Banquet Hall me Hall, Stage, Seating, Parking, Entrance aur Lighting ka poora plan shamil hai — Royal, Garden aur Luxury Style me.

faqs.q: Market Planning me kya hota hai?
faqs.a: Market Planning me Shops, Walkway, Parking aur Lighting ka plan hota hai — Bazaar Style, Shopping Street aur Covered Market me.

processSteps.title: 1. Checkup — Site Visit
processSteps.text: Pehle hum aapke plot ka poora checkup karte hain — size, direction, mitti — jese doctor pehle mareez ko dekhta hai, phir dawa likhta hai.

processSteps.title: 2. Dimagh Ki Soch — Concept Design
processSteps.text: Hum 2-3 layout options banate hain, taake aap apni family ke liye behtareen jism (plan) chun saken.

processSteps.title: 3. Poora Jism Ka Naksha — Detailed Drawings
processSteps.text: Aapki approval ke baad hum poora jism banate hain — Dimagh, Haddiyan, Raghen, Khoon.

processSteps.title: 4. Paidaish Se Jawani Tak — Approval & Construction
processSteps.text: DHA / LDA approval ke baad humari team usi nakshay par building ko paida karti hai — Gray Structure se finishing tak — ek tandrust, mazboot ghar.
